name: DFW 2016 to 2020 under the 2015/2018 IECC (CZ3)
description: The 2015 IRC/IECC became the Texas floor in September 2016 and most DFW cities moved to the 2018 edition locally. Tested envelopes (3 ACH50), R-38 ceilings, R-20 or 13+5 walls, R-8 attic ducts, radiant barrier decking common. One or two stories; stories left to the assessment. Inspect and override.

era.code_basis: 2015 IRC/IECC statewide floor from September 2016; 2018 IECC adopted locally by most DFW cities (SECO, DOE, Texas 2018 compliance guide).

sources.citation: RhoeFlow plan v2, Era-based defaults for DFW table (claude/01-plan/research-and-plan.md); estimates to seed the questionnaire
Texas SECO, single-family energy code history: 2015 IECC floor from September 2016
Texas 2018 Energy Code Compliance Guide (City of North Richland Hills copy)
NAIMA N110-TX Texas Energy Code insulation guide (2025)
RhoeFlow plan v2 §Era-based defaults: radiant barrier common in 2010+ DFW builds

ceiling_insulation_cavity_r.basis: 2015/2018 IECC CZ3 prescriptive ceiling R-38. Replace with the measured depth.

wall_insulation_cavity_r.basis: Prescriptive R-20 cavity, or R-13 cavity plus R-5 continuous. R-20 is assumed; if the wall is 2x4, set cavity to 13 and continuous to 5.

window_ufactor.basis: 2015 IECC CZ3 U-0.35; 2018 edition 0.32. The looser value is assumed; an NFRC sticker replaces it.

air_leakage.basis: 2015/2018 IECC CZ3 tested maximum 3 ACH50. The actual test report replaces this.

duct_leakage_to_outside.basis: Plan table gives 4 cfm25 per 100 ft2, read as total to outside. Needs served floor area to become CFM25 (WO-02 derivation); recorded as skipped until then.

roof_radiant_barrier.basis: Radiant barrier roof decking is common in 2010+ DFW builds. Confirm from the attic photo (foil face on the underside of the deck).
